column9: catalogue sample name is "Glen Clan Smoky Peated Blend" - the whisky's own name states a peated character; no independent citation, inferred directly from the product name per be/CLAUDE.md's existing note on this row.

Het Anker also sells "Gouden Carolus Single Malt Peated" (distilled from a specially composed peated-barley mash); their own site calls it a "soft smoky character" (zacht gerookte toets), hence light rather than medium/heavy.

Great Northern Distillery's range for this brand includes a distinct "Peated Single Malt" expression per an independent whisky database's brand listing (not independently opened this session); the base Blended expression's own lighter peat is recorded on the row itself.
